(September 9) | attendance = | average attendance = | prevseason = [[2025 Major League Soccer season|2025]] | nextseason = [[2027 Major League Soccer season|2027]] | updated = October 14, 2026 | American = yes }}The '''2026 Major League Soccer season''' is the ongoing 31st{{nbsp}}season of [[Major League Soccer]] (MLS), the top professional [[association football|soccer]] league in the United States and Canada. It is also the 48th{{nbsp}}overall season of a national first-division men's soccer league in the United States overseen by the [[United States Soccer Federation]]. The league has 30{{nbsp}}clubs that are divided into the [[Eastern Conference (MLS)|Eastern]] and [[Western Conference (MLS)|Western]] conferences, each with 15{{nbsp}}teams. The regular season is scheduled to run from February{{nbsp}}21 to November{{nbsp}}7, with 34{{nbsp}}matches for each team, primarily against opponents in the same conference. A six-week break was taken from May{{nbsp}}25 to July{{nbsp}}16 for the [[2026 FIFA World Cup]], which was hosted in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The playoffs are scheduled to be played during an uninterrupted period in November and December culminating in [[MLS Cup 2026|MLS Cup{{nbsp}}2026]], the league's postseason championship,{{cite news |last=Becherano |first=Lizzy |date=November 20, 2025 |title=MLS reveals 2026 schedule with 7-week break for World Cup |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/47037809/mls-2026-schedule-break-world-cup |publisher=[[ESPN]] |access-date=November 20, 2025}} on December 18.{{cite web|url=https://www.mlssoccer.com/news/a-letter-from-commissioner-don-garber|title=A letter from Commissioner Don Garber|date=20 February 2026|access-date=20 February 2026|first=Don|last=Garber}} The 2026 season will be the final full season played under the spring–autumn format, as MLS plans to transition to a summer–spring format beginning with the [[2027–28 Major League Soccer season|2027–28{{nbsp}}season]]; a [[2027 Major League Soccer season|shortened season]] with 14{{nbsp}}matches is scheduled to be played in early 2027.{{cite news |last=Sutcliffe |first=Steve
